waivers.reason: This pre-existing event-store monolith received a bounded v4 schema and transition extension. A full storage-layer decomposition is deferred because mixing it with the time-critical pension-flow recovery would broaden migration and rollback risk.

This pre-existing FastAPI route module received the bounded v4 demographics and admin-input endpoints plus one read-only process-review router endpoint. Router decomposition is deferred to a dedicated compatibility change to avoid altering unrelated production routes during flow recovery.

The established pension experiment state machine is a single compatibility boundary used by storage and tests. The v4 procedure is isolated by version branching; broader decomposition is deferred to avoid changing legacy procedure semantics.

The existing end-to-end harness owns shared module-reset, authentication, freeze, and participant fixtures. The v4 scenario stays beside those fixtures; splitting it alone would retain the oversized original while adding brittle cross-module test imports.
